༄༅/ /dam chos dgongs pa yang zab kyi rtsa ba gsum gyi las byang gi kha skong phrin las bzhi'i

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dam chos dgongs pa yang zab kyi rtsa ba gsum gyi las byang gi kha skong phrin las bzhi'i

sbyin sreg bsdus pa bzhugs so// na mo gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī ye/ dam chos dgongs pa yang zab las/ rtsa ba gsum gyi las byang gi kha skong phrin las bzhi'i sbyin sreg mdor bsdus te nyams su blang ba la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// spyi don dang po sngon 'gro'i sdom ni/ dus dang phyogs dang sa chog dang*// stegs bu thab bca' mchod rdzas dang*// sreg rdzas bsags shing bkram pa dang*// bdag bskyed bsang chu me lha yi// mchod pa byin rlabs rdzas bkru sbyangs// byin rlabs me sbar ku sha bkram// zhes bco lnga las/ dang po dus ni// sbyin sreg gi cho ga spyir btang zhi ba la dpyid| rgyas pa la dbyar/ dbang la ston/ drag po dgun/ bye brag tu zhi ba la srod/ rgyas pa la nyi shar/ dbang la dgong ka/ drag po la gung gnyis so// gnyis pa phyogs ni/ bsnyen sgrub tshogs brgya sogs dang 'brel na sgrub khang nang dang*/ bsnyen sgrub tshogs brgya sogs dang ma 'brel na/ grong khyer la sogs pa'i shar du zhi ba/ lhor rgyas pa/ nub tu dbang*/ byang du drag po brtsam mo// gsum pa sa chog ni/ ba glang gi lhas dang*/ rgyal po'i pho brang*/ gtsug lag khang dang*/ sgrub khang sogs su ni sa chog mi dgos la/ gzhan du ni sa chog zhi khro'i dbang phreng ltar la/ de'i lha zhi khro bskyed pa'i mal du rtsa gsum las byang gi mngon rtogs bsgyur ba kho nas 'grub/ bzhi pa stegs bu bca' ba ni/ zhi khro rang yin na dbang phreng dkyus kho na ma gtogs rtsa gsum las byang ltar mi bya/ las mthun kyi thab tshad las che nges pa'i stegs bu gru bzhi pa 'khyud re'i dpangs dang ldan par bya'o// lnga pa thab bca' ba ni/ stegs bu'i steng du zhi ba'i thab rgyar sor mo nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa'i mchu dang kha khyer sor mo bzhi re zlum po/ kha khyer la rdo rje'i phreng ba/ rgyas pa'i thab zhi ba'i rgya las gnyis ldan gru bzhi pa/ kha khyer la rin po che'i phreng ba/

dbang dang de'i dgug pa'i thab sor mo nyi shu pa zla gam kha khyer la pad+mas mtshan pa'i lcags kyu'i phreng ba/ drag po'i thab zhi ba dang rgya mnyam pa gru gsum kha khyer la ral gri'i phreng ba/ thams cad las mthun gyi kha dog dang ldan pa'i lte bar sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zhi ba la 'khor lo dkar po/ rgyas pa la rin po che ser po cha dgu pa/ dbang la pad+ma dmar po dbang gi dgug pa la lcags kyu dmar po/ drag po la ral gri nag po bris pa'i kha khyer/ thab gyi steng du zhi ba la dgon pa'i glang gi lci ba skam po rlan dang srog chags med pa'am/ 'o ma can gyi shing*/ rgyas pa la 'bras bu can gyi shing*/ dbang la me tog dmar po can gyi tsher ma lcags kyu lta bu yod pa/ drag po la ro bsregs pa'i shing ngam/ dur khrod du skyes pa'i shing tsher ma can nam/ dug gi shing de rnams gang yang rung thab kyi rgya'i phyed tshad du brtsegs pas nang bkang zhing dbus sam shar lhor me tshang bca' 'o// drug pa mchod rdzas ni/ zhi ba la dung ngam nya lcibs/ rgyas pa la gser/ dbang la zangs dmar/ drag po la thod pa'am rdza phor du/ zhi rgyas dbang gsum la chu gtsang dri bzang dang*/ 'bras yos til nag gis sbags pa'i chu bzhi/ dri zhim po'i me tog a ka ru dang sih+la sogs kyi spos/ mar dkar gyi mar me/ dri bzang po btab pa'i dri'i chu/ lha bshos zhi ba la 'o ma/ rgyas pa la zho/ dbang la chang gis sbrus pa/ drag po la dug khrag gi chu bzhi/ dbang po lnga'i me tog /sha chen gyi spos/ zhun chen gyi mar me/ mkhris chen gyi dri chab/ khrag gis sbrus pa'i lha bshos so// mchod pa rnams las mthun gyi kha dog dang ldan par bya'o// bdun pa sreg rdzas ni spyi dang khyad par gnyis las/ spyir 'o ma can gyi shing tshad ldan bod du med pas/ tshab rung tsam lcang skya'am/ bal bu 'am/ 'om bu rnams gang 'dzom la/ zhi ba'i yam shing ni de'i rtse mo'i cha las sboms su mthe'u chung ngam/

mdzub mo dang mnyam zhing srid du sor mo bcu gnyis/ rgyas par de'i sked pa las byung ba sboms su 'chang gang srid du khru gang pa/ dbang la me tog dmar po can ro skyur ba'i shing de'i dgug pa la tsher ma lcags kyu lta bu yod pa'i shing la sboms su srin mdzub dang mnyam zhing srid du sor mo dgu pa/ 'jam gsum gyi yam shing skam rul 'bu zos gas pa sogs skyon med pa rtse mo pad+ma kha bye ba'i dbyibs can/ drag po'i yam shing ni/ bud shing dang rgyu 'dra ba la sboms su mthe'u chung dang mnyam pa'i srid du sor bcu pa rtse mo gnyis rnon por bzhogs pa/ zhi ba'i yam shing gi rtse mo mar dang 'o ma/ rgyas pa'i rtse mo dri bzang dang sbrang rtsi/ dbang gi rtse mo tsan+dan dmar po dang*/ de'i dgug pa pho mo'i dri chu/ drag po'i rtse mo dug khrag dang khyi brun dang yungs dmar gyis sbags pa/ de thams cad las mthun gyi dri dang kha dog bsgyur ba/ 'jam gsum la mar dkar gyi khu ba la las mthun gyi kha dog can/ drag po la yungs dmar dang zhun chen/ gzhan yang til/ yungs kar/ nas/ gro/ 'bras/ sran ma rnams shun pa dang sa rdo phub ma sogs med cing bam rul du ma gyur pa ma grug pa/ so ba shun pa dang ldan pa/ shing thog sna tshogs/ durba dang ku sha sngon po mar dang sbrang rtsis sbags pa/ zas mchog 'bras dkar kyi phye ma la zhi ba la 'o ma/ rgyas pa la zho/ dbang la chang gis sbrus pa thams cad kyang mngar gsum dang ldan pa/ drag po'i zas mchog khrag gis sbrus pa rnams so// khyad par gyi rdzas la/ zhi ba la til dkar nag /tsam+pa ka sogs me tog dkar po dri zhim pa dang*/ 'bras yos dang*/ thang chu/ rgyas pa la spos dkar dang*/ me tog ser po dang*/ til dang bza' ba sna tshogs pa| dbang la me tog dmar po dang*/ dri dmar po dang*/ tshong 'dus kyi sa dang*/ phyug po'i bang mdzod kyi nas dang*/ rgyal po'i nor rdzas ji snyed pa sogs rnams so// dbang gi dgug pa la tsan+dan dmar po/

me tog dmar po 'char zhing tsher ma lcags kyu lta bu yod pa'i shing gi byang bu dkyus sor dgu srid du sor lnga pa la dgug bya'i rus pa bris pa'i khong par nṛ'i mthar che ge mo ā kar+ṣa ya dza dzaḥ hrīṃḥhrīṃḥ zhes dang*/ mtha' skor du rtsa gsum gyi sngags hrīḥ'i mthar gong gi sham bu btags pa mgo nang bstan dang*| de'i phyir pad+ma dang lcags kyu sogs phyir bstan pa'i phreng bas bskor ba la pho 'gugs na mo'i dri chu'am pad+ma rak+ta/ mo 'gugs na pho'i dri chu shu kras byugs/ drag po la rnga mo dang bong bu'i sbangs dang*/ phub ma dang*/ 'bru nag gi phye ma dang*/ sa dmar po dang*/ mkhar gong srib can rnams kyi phye ma dug khrag gis sbrus pa'i rū pa sor nyi shu pa'i khong par dgra bgegs gang la bya ba'i ming rus bris la bcug pa dang*/ de thams cad dgra yin na dri ma drug dang bgegs ngos zin na de gnas pa'i sa rdo shing sogs dang*/ ngos ma zin na rlung 'dre tshub byas shul gyi sa sogs kyis sbags shing dug khrag gis byugs pa rnams so// gzhan yang 'jam gsum la mngar gsum dang*/ ha ti su pa ri dang bcas pa'i so rtsi dang*/ drag po la de'i steng rdo thal bsnan pa/ 'jam gsum la las mthun gyi kha dog can gyi gos zung*/ drag po la zhing lpags sam ro ras/ gtor ma 'jam gsum la las mthun gyi kha dog bsgyur ba'i zlum po dang*/ drag po la sha khrag gis sbags pa gru gsum/ gzhan yang dung zhal du gnas pa'i bsang chu dri bzang dang ldan pa/ rlung g.yab/ dgang blugs/ ḍā ma ru/ rdor dril la sogs nyer mkho rnams 'du bya'o// brgyad pa bkram pa ni/ 'jam gsum la rang gi g.yas thab kyi g.yon ngos su/ las mthun gyi kha dog can gyi gdan la/ yam shing*/ til/ yungs kar/ zas mchog /ku sha/ dūrba/ nas/ gro/ 'bras/ sran ma/ so ba/ shing tog sna tshogs rnams mang nyung gnyis re byas pa nyung ba thab ngos me lha'i dang*/ phyi ma mang ba 'das lha'i ste tshar gnyis gral du bshams/

rang gi g.yon thab kyi g.yas ngos su las mthun gyi kha dog dang ldan pa'i gdan la/ mchod yon/ zhabs bsil rnams kyi mdun du bzed zhal dang bcas pa/ 'thor 'thung la ku sha'i chun po btsugs la bshams/ drag po la chu bzhi dang sreg rdzas/ g.yas g.yon go log tu bshams/ rang gi mdun du nyer spyod tshar gnyis thab ngos me lha dang*/ rang ngos 'das lhar bshams shing*/ so so'i mthar rang rang gi gtor ma dang gos zung yang bshams/ rang gi nye logs su mar snod/ mdun du rdor dril gyi bar du dgang blugs kha sbyar ba/ bsnyen sgrub tshogs brgya sogs kyi mthar min pa'i sbyin sreg glo bur ba yin na/ rang gi g.yas su bdag bskyed kyi gtor ma sman rak+ta mchod pa dang bcas pa bshams/ dbang gi dgug pa yin na de'i rū pa zangs dmar gyi snod du gdan dang kha khebs dmar po byas pa dang*/ drag por liṅga lcags snod du phung re'i gdan khebs dang bcas pa bzhag cing*/ thun/ phur pa/ mi bsad pa'i mtshon chas steng nas mnan/ gnod byed dgra bgegs byad ma mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad aṅku sha dzaḥ rang dang thab kyi bar me yol la gangs ri bris pa yang bzhag go// mchod rdzas dang sreg rdzas thams cad la gu gul gyis bdug /sngags kyi hrīḥyig mthar/ zhi ba la/ shān+tiṃ ku ru hūm̐/ rgyas pa la/ puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ dbang la/ wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ dbang gi dgug pa la/ ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥhrīṃ/ drag po la/ mā ra ya phaṭa/ btags pa bzlas te so sor bkod la bzhag /dgu pa bdag bskyed ni/ sgrub pa po 'jam gsum la khrus bya/ dkar po'i kha dog can gyi dris bgos shing rgyan gos dang ldan pas/ zhi ba la/ shar du phyogs pas ku sha'i gdan la rdo rje skyil krung zhi dul gyi sems dang ldan pa/ rgyas pa la/ lhor phyogs pas dri ser pos bgos shing rgyan gos ser po dang ldan pa'i dar zab kyi khri la bzang po'i 'dug stangs tshims shing rangs pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ dbang la/

nub tu phyogs pas dri dmar pos bgos shing gos rgyan dmar po dang ldan pas 'bol la sogs pa'i gdan la pad+ma'i skyil krung brtse zhing chags pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ drag po la/ khrus mi bya bar gdong dang lag pa khrag gis sbags shing rgyan gos nag po dang ldan pas byang du phyogs par sra ba'i gdan nam/ stan med pa'am zhing lpags sam gcan gzan gyi g.yang gzhi'i steng du rkang pa g.yon brkyang gis khro 'khrug gi gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pas 'khod nas/ sbyin sreg glo bur pa'i tshe rtsa gsum las byang gi sngon gtor nas bzung bzlas pa'i bar bya zhing*/ bzlas pa ci 'grub gyi mthar rdzogs rim yan chad grub par bya'o// bcu pa bsang chu bsgrub pa ni/ dung zhal gyi chu la 'khyil ba brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la gdab bo// bcu gcig pa me lha'i mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ bsang sbyang gi mthar/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ nas/ shapada'i bar sbyar ba'o// bcu gnyis pa rdzas bkru sbyang ni/ rdo rje phyir bsdams la gung mo gnyis bsgrengs pa rtse sprad pa me lha'i sreg rdzas rnams la gtad/ oṃ swā hā/ oṃ āḥswā hā/ oṃ shrīṃ swā hā/ oṃ dz+rīṃ swā hā/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ bcu gsum pa me lha'i sreg rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las me lha'i sreg rdzas yam shing la sogs pa rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ ngo bo sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin la rnam pa rdzas so so rang rang gi bya ba byed nus par gyur pa dang*/ rdzas sngags so so lan gsum re bzla'o// bcu bzhi pa me sbar ba ni/ zhi ba la/ dge 'dun gyi tshang mang ngam me shel las byung ba'i me/ rgyas pa la/ rgyal po'i thab chen nam nags la me shor ba'i me/ dbang la/ gar mkhan nam tshong dus sam tshos mkhan gyi me/ dbang gi dgug pa la/ smad 'tshong ma'i khyim gyi me/

drag po la/ rabs chad dam/ yug sa ma'am/ bshan pa'am/ rdo dang lcags brdabs pa'i me'o// de rnams gang yin yang las mthun gyi me snod du bzhag la/ 'khyil ba bzlas pa'i bsang chus 'jam gsum la g.yas skor dang*/ drag po la g.yon skor du lan gsum bsang*/ me sbar nas de nyid kyi dpal 'bar dang ku sha'i chun po lhan cig par sbar ba yang gong ltar/ bsangs la thab kyi me tshang du bcug ste/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ slar yang*/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes rlung g.yab kyis me gso/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes mar khu blugs gzar gsum gyis me gso| bco lnga pa ku sha dgram pa ni/ ku sha'i chun po rnams thogs la/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ oṃ/ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge// tshangs pa lha rnams dag byed cing*// dkon mchog gsum po mnyes byed pa| |sa las skyes pa 'dab ma'i snying*// bdag gi bgegs rnams thams cad ni// zhi zhing bkra shis mdzad du gsol// swā hā/ zhes 'jam gsum la snga ma'i rtsa ba phyi ma'i rtse mos non par g.yas skor dang*/ drag po la g.yon skor du thab steng du dgram/ chun po che ba gcig ba glang gi rna ba ltar thab steng du g.yogs pa ni las bzhi gar bya'o// spyi don gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i sdom ni/ thab dang lha bskyed spyan drangs te// bgegs bskrad cha bzhi phul la bstim// dam bzhag mchod 'bul dbang bskur la// byon skyems 'bul zhing me pra brtag /mchod bstod rdzas 'bul nyer spyod dang*// bstod de 'das lha'i mchod rdzas dag /byin rlabs lha bskyed spyan drangs shing*// mchod bstod 'dzab bzlas byon skyems 'bul// mchod bstod rdzas 'bul phrin las bcol// tshogs mchod so rtsi gtor ma dang*// gos zung phul dang phyag 'tshal nas// bzod par gsol zhing gshegs su gsol// zhes pa ltar don tshan so gsum las/ dang po thab dang lha bskyed pa ni/ thab dang me bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ zhi ba la/

hūm̐ las byung ba'i zhi ba'i thab khung zlum po/ dkar po mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du ye shes kyi me dkar zhing g.yas su 'khyil ba'i dbus su/ chu dkyil la gnas pa'i pad nyi'i gdan la raṃ dang bgrang phreng las skyes pa'i zhi ba'i me lha 'dzin byed dkar po zhi zhing 'dzum pa'i nyams can gos rgyan dkar po 'chang zhing sems dpa'i skyil krung gis gnas pa/ zhes dang*/ rgyas pa la/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i rgyas pa'i thab khung gru bzhi ser po mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du ye shes kyi me ser zhing g.yas su 'khyil ba'i dbus su/ sa dkyil la gnas pa'i pad nyi'i gdan la raṃ dang bgrang phreng las skyes pa'i rgyas pa'i me lha dbang chen ser po tshim zhing rangs pa'i nyams can gos rgyan ser po 'chang zhing bzang po'i 'dug stangs kyis gnas pa/ zhes dang*/ dbang la/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i dbang gi thab khung zla gam dmar po mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du ye shes kyi me dmar zhing g.yas su 'khyil ba'i dbus su/ rlung dkyil la gnas pa'i pad nyi'i gdan la raṃ dang bgrang phreng las skyes pa'i dbang gi me lha sku mdog dmar ba brtse zhing chags pa'i nyams can gos rgyan dmar po 'chang zhing pad+ma'i skyil krung gis gnas pa/ zhes dang*/ drag po la/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i drag po'i thab khung gru gsum nag po mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du ye shes kyi me dmar nag 'tshub cing g.yon du 'khyil ba'i dbus su/ me dkyil la gnas pa'i pad nyi'i gdan la raṃ dang bgrang phreng las skyes pa'i drag po'i me lha rlung can sku mdog nag po khro 'khrug khams gsum za ba'i nyams can gos rgyan nag po 'chang zhing g.yon brkyang gis gnas pa/ zhes so sor sbyar zhing*/ bzhi ga thun mong du/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis mi 'jigs pa dang bgrang phreng*/ g.yon gnyis dbyug pa rtse gsum dang ril ba spyi blugs bsnams pa ral pa'i thor gtsug dang ag tshom sogs drang srong gi cha lugs can snying khar me dkyil la raṃ gyis mtshan pas spras pa/

rang 'dra'i 'khor du mas yongs su bskor bar gyur par bsam/ gnyis pa spyan drang ba ni/ 'dod rgyal gyi phyag rgya bcas la/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon dang me lha'i snying kha'i raṃ yig las lcags kyu lta bu 'od zer 'phros pas shar lho nas ye shes kyi me lha 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ ṭak+ki hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes dang*/ slar rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag g.yas skyabs sbyin gyi rtsa bar srin lag bcug pa'i mkhrig ma nas g.yon dril bu dang bcas pas gzung ba bstan la/ oṃ/ tshur spyon tshur spyon 'byung po che// lha yi drang srong bram ze mchog |sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'dir ni yang dag bsnyen mdzad nas// rdo rje 'chang gi bka' bzhin mdzod// oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ spyan drangs la/ gsum pa bgegs bskrad pa ni/ phyi 'brang gi bgegs thams cad oṃ suṃ bha ni sogs brjod/ yungs kar gyis brab/ bzhi pa chu bzhi dbul ba ni/ oṃ āḥhrīḥpra wa ra sat+kā raṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ/ ā tsa mā naṃ/ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ gyis 'bul/ lnga pa bstim pa ni/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ me lha dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa dgug pa dang*/ gzhug pa dang*/ bcing ba dang*/ dbang du bya zhing mnyes par byas nas gnyis su med par gyur par bsam/ drug pa dam la bzhag pa ni/ lag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas rtse gsum gyi phyag rgya bstan la/ oṃ badz+ra a na la ma hā bhū ta dz+wa la dz+wa la ya sarba bhasmiṃ ku ru sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ dṛ sh+ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya hoḥ bdun pa mchod pa ni/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ nas/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ brgyad pa dbang bskur ba ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis dbang gi lha rigs lnga yab yum spyan drangs/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lhas bum pa dkar po byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams nas/

sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// gsang gsum gnas las legs skyes pa// rdo rje'i gsang ba gsum byung ba// bum pa'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba las rigs lngas dbu brgyan| dbang gi lha rnams me lha la thim par gyur/ dgu pa byon zan 'bul ba ni/ dgang gzar mar gyis bkang ba'i steng du blugs gzar mar gyis bkang ba kha gyen bstan du brtsegs pa thogs la/ me lha'i zhal 'jam gsum la cung zad gdangs pa dang*/ drag po la cher gdangs pa'i ljags la raṃ yig dang*/ dgang blugs kyi kha la hrīḥyig las mthun gyi kha dog can gsal bar gyur par dmigs la/ oṃ ag+na ye a dī bya ā bi sha ā bi sha ma hā shrī ye ha bya ka bya bā ha na ye swā hā/ bdun 'bul/ bcu pa me pra brtag pa ni/ zhi ba'i me dkar zhing zlum pa rtse mo gcig pa dung dkar lta bu/ rgyas pa'i me ser zhing gru bzhi pa brjid chags pa rin po che cha dgu pa lta bu/ dbang gi me dmar zhing gsal ba zla gam pad+ma'i dbyibs can/ de'i dgug pa la me lcags kyu lta bu/ 'jam gsum ka'i me g.yas su 'khyil zhing 'bar ba dri zhim pa bzang*/ drag po'i me nag cing rtsub la sgra dang bcas pa gru gsum pa g.yon du 'khor zhing mtshon cha'i dbyibs can dri mi zhim pa bzang*/ de rnams go ldog na bsang chus bsangs shing bsnyen sngags kyis dgang blugs bdun dang*/ 'khyil ba'i sngags kyis dgang blugs gsum phul la bgegs bsal lo// bcu gcig pa mchod pa ni/ sngar ltar chu bzhi dang*/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ nas/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ bcu gnyis pa bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ */ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mchog gi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ṭak+kis dbang bsgyur ba// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg

/zhi ba la/ 'dzin byed/ rgyas pa la/ dbang chen/ dbang la/ dmar po/ drag po la/ rlung chen zhes bsgyur nas/ me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ ces bstod/ bcu gsum pa rdzas 'bul ba ni/ yam shing zung du sbyar ba/ oṃ ag+na ye badz+ra ya dz+nyā ya bdag gi= zhi ba la/ gang zhi bar 'dod pa che ge mo shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ rgyas pa la/ gang rgyas par 'dod pa che ge mo puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ dbang la/ gang dbang du bya ba che ge mo wa sh+yaṃ ku ru hoḥ de dag gi dgug pa la/ che ge mo ā kar+ṣa ya zhes pa'i mthar pho yin na dza dzaḥ mo yin na hrīṃ hrīṃ sbyar ba/ drag po la/ che ge mo mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces bsgyur ba rdzas kun la 'gre bas/ mar khu la/ ag+na ye= 'byor pa phun sum tshogs= til la/ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ya= sdig pa'i gnyen po phun sum tshogs= yungs kar la/ sarba ar+tha sā dha ya= bgegs kyi gnyen po phun sum tshogs= zas mchog la/ sarba sam+pa de= shes rab dang bde ba phun sum tshogs= ku sha la/ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ya= bsrung ba phun sum tshogs= dūrba la/ badz+ra ā yuḥṣe= tshe phun sum tshogs= nas la/ ma hā be gā ya= myur ba'i shugs phun sum tshogs= gro la/ badz+ra ghasma ri ye= nad med pa phun sum tshogs= 'bras la/ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ya= dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs= sran ma la/ ma hā ba lā ya= lus kyi stobs phun sum tshogs= so ba la/ badz+ra bi dzā ya= nor dang 'bru phun sum tshogs= shing thog sna tshogs la/ oṃ badz+ra sho pa le= rigs rgyud phun sum tshogs= rdzas khyad par ba rnams la/ oṃ ag+ni de wa ta= zhes sbyar bas grangs ji ltar rigs pa 'bul/ bcu bzhi pa mchod pa ni/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ bco lnga pa bstod pa ni/ me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha// drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho me lha'i tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// bcu drug pa 'das lha'i mchod pa dang sreg rdzas rnams sngar me lha'i skabs ltar byin brlabs/ bcu bdun pa lha bskyed mchod pa ni/

me lha me dpung 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur pa'i dbus su| rgyas par na/ 'gro kun zhi khro byed na/ 'byung ba rim brtsegs ri rab dang cas pa'i steng*/ bsgral phyir rgyu mchog yi ge hrīḥ zhes pa nas sam/ bsdu na/ khrag zhag zhi khro la/ lte ba mthing kha mu khyud ser po can gyi chos kyi 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs bzhi pa sogs nas bzung ste/ rgya mtsho pad+ma nyi zla'i steng*// zhes pa nas/ de gnyis kar bdag rig ces pa'i mal du/ sa bon hrīḥlas skad cig ces dang*/ sku mdog rab dmar 'tsher zhes par/ zhi ba la/ rab dkar 'tsher/ rgyas pa la/ rab ser 'tsher/ dbang la/ dkyus de ga /drag po la/ rab nag 'tsher/ zhes bsgyur/ hrīḥ bdag nyid dpal bo rta mgrin zhes par/ khro rgyal dpa' bo rta mgrin yab yum gyi// dung khang zhes bsgyur// lha tshogs spyan drangs gyur gyi bar dang*/ bco brgyad pa spyan drang ba/ bcu dgu pa mchod pa/ nyi shu pa bstod pa/ nyer gcig pa 'dzab bzla ba rnams rtsa gsum 'di'i bar zhi khro'i dkyil chog don gnyis myur 'grub kyi mdun bskyed nyid/ mchan/ las byang dkyus ltar bya/ nyer gnyis pa byon zan 'bul ba ni/ dgang blugs mar gyis bkang ba brtsegs pa me lha'i skabs ltar bzung la/ lha rnams 'jam gsum la zhal cung zad gdangs pa/ drag po la cher gdangs pa'i ljags la raṃ yig dang*/ dgang blugs kyi kha la hrīḥyig las mthun gyi kha dog can gyis mtshan par gyur par dmigs la// gzhung 'dzab kyi hrīḥ'i mthar/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes me lha'i sngags btags la lan bdun gyis 'jam gsum la g.yas skor dang drag po la g.yon skor du 'bul/ nyer gsum pa mchod pa ni/ oṃ gu ru de wa zhi khro la/ pañca shan+takro dha zhes bsgyur/ ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra āḥhrīḥpra wa ra sat+kā raṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ/ ā tsa mā naṃ/ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ gyis chu bzhi dang*/

oṃ gu ru de wa zhi khro la/ pañca shan+ta kro ta de wa zhes bsgyur| ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ nas/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ nyer bzhi pa bstod pa ni/ ma bcos spros bral ma dang*/ ma chags skyon bral mas bstod/ zhi khro la bstod pa 'di gnyis kyi tshab tu/ hūm̐ ming gzugs rnam shes sogs zhi khro'i bum bskyed kyi bstod pa la las bum gyi bstod pa ma sbyar bas bstod/ zhi khro la gzhung 'dzab kyi mal du zhi khro'i mtshan sngags gsum dril na oṃ pañca shan+ta kro dha de wa zhes bsgyur| nyer lnga pa rdzas 'bul ba ni/ gzhung 'dzab kyi hrīḥ'i mthar/ badz+ra ya dz+nyā ya/ zhes par las mthun gyi sham bu sngar me lha'i skabs bshad pa ltar btags pas 'bul ba ni shing thog sna tshogs gyi bar 'gre/ rdzas khyad par ba zhi rgyas dbang dang*/ dbang gi dgug pa'i byang bu rnams la ni gzhung 'dzab kyi hrīḥ'i zhi khro yin na bsgyur/ mthar las mthun gyi sham bu btags pa kho nas 'bul/ yang rdzas thams cad ma 'byor yang yam shing dang mar khu med du mi rung*/ nyer drug pa phrin las bcol ba ni/ zhi ba la/ lha gtso bo'i thugs ka nas zhi ba'i lha mo dkar mo zla ba chu shel gyi bum pa thogs pa spros/ bdag gam bsgrub bya la dbang bskur zhing khrus byas pas gang zhi bar 'dod pa de dag zhi bar gyur par bsam/ rgyas pa la/ rgyas pa'i lha mo ser mo gser gyi bum pa thogs pa spros/ bdag gam bsgrub bya la dbang bskur zhing khrus byas pas gang rgyas par 'dod pa de ches cher 'phel zhing rgyas par bsam/ dbang la/ dbang gi lha mo dmar mo byi ru'i bum pa thogs pa spros/ bdag gam bsgrub bya la dbang bskur zhing khrus byas pas gang dbang du bya bar 'dod pa de dag skad cig la dbang du 'du bar bsam/ dbang gi dgug pa la/ lha mo dmar mo byi ru'i bum pa dang lcags kyu zhags pa mda' zhu thogs pa spros/ dbang du bsdu bya gang yin de'i snying nas lcags kyus btab/

ske nas zhags pas khrid de bdag gi mdun du bkugs pa la pad+ma dmar po'i mde'u can gyi mda' de snying la bsnun pas bdag gi bran du gyur cing*/ bdag dang de la dbang bskur zhing khrus mdzad pas rang dbang med par phan tshun brtse gdung dang ldan zhing 'bral ba med par bdag gi bran dang bka' nyan gsung sdod dbang du 'dus par bsam/ drag po'i skabs ni/ liṅga la dgug gzhug lan brgya'am nyer gcig gsum sogs do gal dang bstun pa byas rjes gzhung 'dzab kyi hrīḥ'i zhi khro la bsgyur/ mthar che ge mo aṃ ku sha dza dzaḥ btags pa ci 'grub bzlas rjes hrīḥ'i zhi khro la bsgyur/ mthar che ge mo rak+ṣa ka ra pañca de wa ta uts+tsha ta ya phaṭa/ ces ci 'grub kyi kha sbyor dbye/ hrīḥ'i zhi khro la bsgyur/ mthar badz+ra kī la ya sarba bigh+nāṃ baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces gnas rnams su phur bus btab/ mi bsad pa'i mtshon cha thogs la/ hūm̐ hrīḥm/ rtsa gsum zhi khro dam can srung ma'i tshogs// zhes pa nas/ gnas 'dir khug /ces pa'i bar dang*/ hrīḥ'i mthar che ge mo kā ya wāka tsit+ta hur thuṃ dzaḥmyag thuṃ ril mā ra ya rbad sod/ ces dum bur bsgral/ de nas pho yin na mthe'u g.yas/ mo yin na g.yon nas rim pas thab tu 'bul zhing*/ bsgral ba'i zhing gyur bsgral ba'i zhes pa nas/ thugs su bstim gyi mthar hrīḥ'i zhi khro la bsgyur/ mjug tu/ a mu kaṃ sha trūṃ ma hā maṃ sa/ rak+ta/ tsit+ta/ go ro tsa na/ ba su ta/ keṃ ni ri ti/ skan+dha/ dhā tu/ in+d+ra/ kā ya wāka tsit+ta la kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lhag ma med par 'bul/ slar yang gtso bo'i thugs ka nas drag po'i lha mo nag mo bai ḍūr+ya'i bum pa thogs pa spros/ bzas po'i rnam par shes pa bkug la dbang bskur zhing khrus byas pas sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad sbyangs/ de nyid a dkar por gyur pa gtso bo'i thugs kar bstims/ dbu ma'i lam brgyud rdo rje'i sbub nas yum gyi pad+mar byung ba dbang chen yab yum gyi skur gyur pa mkha' gsang nas spros pas/

'og min gyi gnas su dpal kun tu bzang po'i go 'phang skad cig la thob par bsam mo// nyer bdun pa tshogs mchod ni/ tshogs rdzas rnams gcan gzan nam zhing lpags kyi steng du bshams la/ hūm̐ hrīḥm/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gyi 'phro 'du'i me zhes pa nas/ bsgral mchod kyi bar las byang dkyus ltar btang*/ tshogs phud cha gsum thab nang du phul/ tshogs la longs spyod/ lhag ma btang ngo*// nyer brgyad pa so rtsi ni/ oṃ badz+ra tam+bu lā ye swā hā/ zhes dbul/ nyer dgu pa gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ blugs gzar du bcug /oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmaḥṇāṃ ād+ya nut+pan+na twāta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ gsum gyis byin brlabs la/ hūm̐ hrīḥm/ rtsa gsum zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la// rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar bdud rtsi'i sprin// rgyu gnyis rkyen gsum sbyar ba'i rak+ta mchog /dam rdzas rmad byung gtor mas mchod par bgyi/ */ hrīḥ'i zhi khro la bsgyur/ mthar sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ sman dang*/ hrīḥ'i zhi khro la bsgyur/ mthar ma hā rak+ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ rak+ta dang*/ hrīḥ'i zhi khro la bsgyur/ mthar ma hā ba ling+ta kha raṃ khā hi/ gtor ma thab tu 'bul/ sum cu pa gos zung ni/ sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab bkra zhing*// gang la reg na bde ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'i// gos bzang rin chen bdag blo sbyang phyir 'bul// bzod pa dam pa'i gos kyis brgyan par shog /oṃ badz+ra wā sa s+ye pra tīts+tsha swā hās 'bul/ so gcig pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ oṃ gu ru de zhi khro la/ pañca shan+ta kro dha de wa zhes bsgyur/ wa ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra pā da ban+da naṃ ka ro mi na mo na maḥ zhes phyag 'tshal/ so gnyis pa bzod par gsol ba ni/ thal mo snying gar sbyar la/ ma 'byor yongs su ma rnyed cing*// chad lhag nor 'khrul gyur pa dang*// gang yang nus pa ma mchis pa// rtsa ba gsum la bzod par gsol// oṃ gu ru de wa zhi khro la bsgyur/

ḍā ki nī sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ sogs lan gsum brjod/ so gsum pa gshegs su gsol ba ni/ oṃ/ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzod// ji lta'i rjes mthun dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// badz+ra muḥ rtsa ba gsum gyi ye shes zhes pa/ rgyal ba zhi khro zhes bsgyur/ pa rang bzhin gnas su gshegs/ zhes se gol dang*/ slar rdo rje bsdu ba'i rgyas/ dam tshig pa rnams rang gi srog rtsol nang du 'jug pa dang lhan cig tu bsdus te rang gi snying ga'i sa bon la thim par gyur par bsam mo// spyi don gsum pa mjug sdom ni/ me lha gsal btab dgang blugs 'bul// chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mo dang*// rdzas lhag 'bul zhing bstod nas kyang*| |so rtsi gtor ma gos zung dang*// nyer spyod 'bul zhing bstod nas ni// bzod gsol gshegs bsdu shis pa brjod// ces pa ltar bcu bzhi las/ dang po me lha gsal btab pa ni/ me lha'i sngags kyis sreg blugs gcig phul la/ me lha me dpung 'bar ba'i rnam pa las/ slar sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan chas yongs su rdzogs pa 'bar ba'i phreng ba dang lhan cig par gsal bar gyur par dmigs/ gnyis pa dgang blugs 'bul ba ni/ sngar byon zan gyi skabs ltar sngags ring gis dgang blugs gsum 'bul/ gsum pa chu bzhi ni/ pra wa ra sat+kā raṃ sogs kyis sngar ltar 'bul/ bzhi pa nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa'ang sngar ltar 'bul/ lnga pa rdzas lhag ma 'bul ba ni/ yam shing nas rdzas khyad par ba'i bar mang nyung ci 'dug kyang lan gsum res lhag ma med par byas la me lha'i sngags la rdzas sngags btags pa sngar me lha'i skabs ltar 'bul/ drug pa bstod pa ni/ me ste bsreg bya sogs gang yang rung bas bstod/ bdun pa so rtsi ni/ oṃ badz+ra tam+bu lā ye swā hās 'bul/ brgyad pa gtor ma ni/ me lha'i gtor ma blugs gzar du bzhag par sman raka bran/

oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmaḥṇāṃ ād+ya nut+pan+na twāta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ gzi brjid chen po me yi lha// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun grub mdzod kyi bar brjod cing thab tu 'bul/ dgu pa gos zung ni/ srab 'jam yang pa lha yi gos// mi shigs rdo rje'i sku nyid la// mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul gyi// bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ badz+ra was+t+ra ye swā hās 'bul/ bcu pa nyer spyod ni sngar ltar dang*| bcu gcig pa bstod pa ni/ bstod par 'os pa thams cad la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi// lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu// mchog tu dad pas bstod par bgyi// zhes bstod// bcu gnyis pa bzod par gsol ba ni/ cho ga chad lhag byung ba dang*// ma 'byor ma rnyed la sogs pa// nongs pa gang gyur bzod gsol gyis// tshang zhing dag nas dgyes par mdzod// ces dang*/ yi ge brgya pa brjod/ bcu gsum pa gshegs su gsol ba ni/ se gol gyi sgra dang bcas pas/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// sgrub byed bsreg bya za ba gshegs// ji lta'i dus su slar byon la// bdag gi re 'bras mchis par mdzod// badz+ra muḥ me lha ye shes pa rang gi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa me 'bar ba'i klong du thim par gyur/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmaḥṇāṃ ād+ya nut+pan+na twāta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ bcu bzhi pa shis pa brjod pa ni/ na mo/ byin rlabs mkha' la thugs rje'i sprin 'khrigs te// sogs rtsa gsum las byang dkyus ltar dang*/ gzhan yang shis brjod gang 'os sbyar/ long yod na 'jam gsum gyi me rang shir btang*/ long med na 'o ma dang dri bzang gi chu dang bcas pas gzhil nas/ zhi thal chu bo chen po'i klong du bskyal lo// rgyas thal bang mdzod du sba/ dbang thal ri rtse mthon po'i rtser rlung la 'phyar|

drag po'i me dug khrag gis gzhil la lam rgya gram du skyel lam/ gnon nam/ sde brgyad drag po gnas pa'i sar bskyal lo// de rjes sbyin sreg gi las glo bur pa yin na/ bdag bskyed kyi rjes chog bskul/ chad mdo/ brtan skyong sogs las byang dkyus ltar bya/ bsnyen sgrub tshogs brgya sogs kyi skabs yin na sbyin sreg gi sngon du bdag bskyed zur du mi dgos pas rjes chog rnams kyang mi bya ba yin no// de ltar rtsa gsum las byang gi lhan thabs las bzhi'i sbyin sreg 'di yang rtsa gsum las byang nyid du rgyal dbang rat+na'i gsung gis dngos grub rdzas kyi phud rtsa ba gsum la sbyin sreg 'bul zhes zhal 'phang mdzad pa/ de nyid sngags gsar rnying gi phrin las la byang ba dag gis ni ji ltar bgyis kyang sla mod/ rang nyid lta bu blo gros kyi mthu brtul por song ba rnams kyis sreg chog gzhan gyi kha skong ba yang dka' ba'i phyir dkyus su bris pa 'di'ang*/ 'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong rat+na gnyis pa chos kyi grags pas zu re mgo 'jo'i thang du byang rgyud rgyal po hor dpon btsun chung gis sku gsung thugs kyi rten mang dag bzhengs pa'i rab tu gnas par phyin tshe sgar thog tu mgyogs par bris pa yin no// slar zhi khro rigs bsdus kyi dkyil chog la sbyor tshul gyi mchan bu yang rtsom pa po rang nyid kyis btab bo// //maṅga laṃ//
